acceptance_criteria: Integration tests: parse valid MDN blob → correct Mdn object with all fields; parse non-MDN blob → notParsable; parse unknown blobId → notFound; forEmailId correctly set when originalMessageId matches known sent email
description: Implement handle_mdn_parse in src/mdn.rs. Parses raw RFC 5322 blobs as MDN messages and returns structured MDN objects.
design:
Request args: accountId, blobIds: Id[].

Pre-flight: verify accountId; reject with invalidArguments if not found. If blobIds count exceeds server maximum, reject with requestTooLarge.

Delegate to backend.parse_mdns(account_id, blob_ids).

Backend categorizes each blob id into one of:
  - parsed: successfully parsed as MDN → Mdn object
  - notParsable: blob found but not a valid multipart/report / message/disposition-notification
  - notFound: blob id does not exist

Response: { accountId, parsed: Id[MDN]|null, notParsable: Id[]|null, notFound: Id[]|null }
All three response fields are null (not empty array/object) if the respective category is empty.

forEmailId: backend sets this by looking up the originalMessageId (RFC 5322 Message-ID header from the MDN's Original-Message-ID field) against the account's sent mail. May be null if:
  - originalMessageId field is absent in the MDN
  - No matching message found
  - Server cannot efficiently compute the correlation

Disposition field normalization: actionMode, sendingMode, type MUST be lowercased — the underlying RFC 8098 format is case-insensitive but draft §2 requires lowercase in JMAP responses.

extensionFields: pass through any extension-field headers from the message/disposition-notification part as String[String] map.

Spec ref: draft-ietf-jmap-mdn-17 §2.2, §3.3.
notes:
CORRECTIONS (from research phase):

1. Blob size cap: before calling backend.parse_mdns, check blob count against server limit (requestTooLarge if exceeded). Additionally, within the backend parse_mdns impl, the per-blob size SHOULD be capped before parsing. Suggest: if blob bytes > 1 MiB, classify as notParsable with a comment noting the size limit.

2. forEmailId correlation is best-effort: if originalMessageId from the parsed MDN cannot be correlated to a known email in the account, forEmailId is null. This is NOT an error — spec explicitly allows this to be null when correlation is unavailable.

3. handler signature (no call_id needed — no extra invocations):
   pub async fn handle_mdn_parse<B: MailBackend + MdnBackend>(backend: &B, args: Value) -> Result<(Value, Vec<Invocation>), JmapError>
title: mdn: MDN/parse handler
